comparison.objective: Place an oversized casting onto 3-2-1 locating pins; body and specs are absent, so tolerances and damage rules are unspecified.
comparison.physical_skill: Sliding and aligning a large ungrippable workpiece over locating pins, unlike stabilizing a narrow mandrel, delivering an impact, and recovering fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Casting seated on its locating pins; exact pose thresholds and failure criteria are missing. No fracture or fragment-containment requirement is stated.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is fixture placement of a bulky part, not contact-driven notch fracture and recovery of released tangs.
